title: La sobremesa
subtitle: Coffee and conversation after dinner
scene: The plates are empty, but nobody gets up. It’s time for la sobremesa.

lines.es: Sí, gracias. Con un poco de azúcar.
lines.en: Yes, thanks. With a little sugar.

lines.note: Pan dulce: Mexican sweet bread, like conchas. Perfect with coffee.

lines.es: ¡Qué rico! Señora, ¿le ayudo con los platos?
lines.en: Yum! Ma’am, can I help you with the dishes?

culture.title: La sobremesa
culture.text: After a meal, families stay at the table talking for a long time. Leaving right after eating can seem rude. Relax and listen.

lines.es: No, no, siéntate. Tú eres nuestro invitado.
lines.en: No, no, sit down. You’re our guest.

lines.es: Por favor, señora. Me gusta ayudar.
lines.en: Please, ma’am. I like to help.

lines.es: {me} ya es parte de la familia.
lines.en: {me} is already part of the family.
